verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents alerts triggered by a new hire, a new work location, or a law change creating a compliance obligation. The generic "alerts and notifications" about payroll runs and the AI texts about time-data inconsistencies are adjacent features. Automated tax filing and the Workforce API webhooks are a different feature and a developer building block, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get proactive alerts when a new hire, location, or law change creates a compliance obligation
